test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 2684π cm², and the diameter of its base is 44 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the cone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Diameter** = 44 cm → **Radius (r)** = 22 cm.

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = πrl = 2684π ⇒ 22 × l = 2684.

**Slant height (l)** = 2684 ÷ 22 = 122 cm.

Apply **Pythagoras Theorem**: h = √(l² − r²) = √(122² − 22²) = √((122 − 22)(122 + 22)).

h = √(100 × 144) = 10 × 12 = 120 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 2684π cm²

**Diameter** = 44 cm ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 44 ÷ 2 = 22 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of cone = πrl

Slant height (l) = √(h² + r²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/799d616b3777c61d296d271fa3050187dd9687cb04e70b4baf29508bedf8aa59.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ π × 22 × l = 2684π

⇒ 22 × l = 2684

⇒ l = 2684 ÷ 22 = 122 cm

⇒ l² = r² + h²

⇒ 122² = 22² + h²

⇒ h² = 122² − 22²

⇒ h² = (122 − 22)(122 + 22) [Using a² − b² = (a−b)(a+b)]

⇒ h² = 100 × 144

⇒ h = √(14400) = 120 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 120 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

It includes the curved area and the circular base area: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of Cone

The space occupied by the cone: V = (1/3)πr²h.

Slant Height Relation

In a right circular cone, the height, radius, and slant height form a right-angled triangle: l² = h² + r².</p
